agent2_model_free_baseline.file: src/baselines/model_free_proximal.py -> MinimaxValueBridgeOPE (Shi ICML 2022, chosen over Nair-Jiang for tabular tractability)
agent2_model_free_baseline.math: policy-DEPENDENT value bridge b_V^[t](a,o) via tabular minimax GMM: E[b_V(A_t,O_t)|A_t,O_0] = E[(R_t + V_{t+1}(O_{t+1})) pi_e(A|O) | A_t,O_0], O_0 = past-proxy instrument. Collapses to per-stage regularized GLS beta=(A Wreg A^T + N rho I)^{-1} A Wreg c. BACKWARD recursion carries target-policy continuation; J = E_{o~nu_1}[V_1(o)] on the policy-INDEPENDENT initial marginal.

comprehensive_result.headline: On the 720x2 benchmark, NAIVE dominates all bridge methods at every (kappa,N) (MAE 0.013-0.078, improving with N). This confirms + generalizes the Entry-9 boundary result across the full confounding range, not just kappa in {0,1}.
comprehensive_result.MB_plain: 0.079-0.175 MAE; does not beat naive anywhere at benchmark scale.
comprehensive_result.MB_js: best model-based in several strong-confounding cells (kappa=0.25 N=60k: 0.052 vs plain 0.175; kappa=1 N=60k: 0.084 vs 0.119; kappa=0.5 N=60k: 0.059 vs 0.090) but NOISY across the grid -- the JS factor can over-shrink at small N (kappa=0.75 N=5k: 0.336). Net: variance-reduction helps at large N under confounding but is not a uniform win; still above naive.
comprehensive_result.MF_proximal: WORST and FLATTEST (~0.165-0.180 at every N and kappa). Signature of UNDER-IDENTIFICATION: a binary O_0 proxy cannot pin the 1442-dim value bridge, so MAE does not improve with N (the MAE-vs-N panel shows a flat line while naive descends). A genuine finding: the model-free value-bridge OPE needs a RICHER proxy to scale; the model-based factored estimator sidesteps this by exploiting the core-diagonal 2x2 structure (only the binary marker is unknown per core).
comprehensive_result.MF_toy_consistency: On the TOY (|O|=3, identified) MF is CONSISTENT: max|MF-Vtrue|=0.0076 @200k -- so the flatness is benchmark under-identification, not a code bug.
comprehensive_result.landscape_summary: Model-based > model-free at benchmark scale (MF under-identified by the binary proxy), but BOTH are dominated by confounding-blind naive because per-cell/per-bridge estimation VARIANCE exceeds the small structural confounding bias at feasible N. Shrinkage (js) narrows the model-based gap under strong confounding but does not close it. The through-line of the whole project holds: variance, not identification, is the operative wall at 720x2.

phase4_pessimism.modules: src/pessimism/ellipsoid_opt.py (BlockEllipsoid: H = T2 + lam2*I, exact ellipsoid, closed-form linear min b_hat - sqrt(xi)*H^{-1}g/||g||_{H^-1}, optional signal-subspace projection; pessimistic_value: blockwise coordinate descent + multi-restart) + src/pessimism/pessimistic_optimizer.py (sigma2-calibrated widths xi_t = c/(N2*sigma2_t), coverage instrumentation, selection harness)
phase4_pessimism.HEADLINE_FINDING_vanilla_eq17_blowup: The literal anchor Eq.-17 joint minimization is catastrophically loose at coverage-guaranteeing widths: at the smallest c with joint coverage=1 (c=0.1), V_low(best policy) = -1.12 (outside the feasible [0,3] value range!) and selection regret = 0.684; V_low diverges (-61 at c=1, -1755 at c=10). Mechanism: structural |O|>|S| null directions have H-weight only lam2; the JOINT multilinear min couples null perturbations across blocks (b_D moves rotate the chain state off the emission row-space, making downstream null components value-relevant). Verified by restart-gap growth (1e-13 -> 38).
phase4_pessimism.REPAIR_signal_projected_pessimism: Restrict each region to the empirically identified signal subspace (per-action eigengap eigenvectors of the design (x) identity on the index space -- Nair-Jiang-style rank restriction, built from the SAME spectra as the sigma2 width rule; no oracle input). Result: joint coverage onset improves 0.1 -> 0.03 (truth's projection covered at 3x smaller widths since null-direction junk excluded), and AT the coverage onset c=0.03: V_low informative (1.346 for best policy), ZERO selection regret, all lower bounds valid, restart gaps ~1e-12. Vanilla has NO c with coverage=1 AND regret=0.
phase4_pessimism.V4_foundational_guarantee: V_low <= V_true holds for ALL policies, seeds, and c values in BOTH variants (PASS; asserted under joint coverage, empirically true everywhere)
phase4_pessimism.caveat: V_low <= V_true is verified EMPIRICALLY (V4: all policies/seeds/widths, both variants), NOT algorithmically certified. AUDIT-CLARIFIED (Entry 8): the blockwise coordinate-descent min UPPER-bounds the exact inner min (reward blocks solved globally & exactly; the T-1 coupled dynamic blocks heuristically), so even at c >= coverage onset -- where the truth is feasible and the EXACT inner min would be <= V_true -- the computed V_low could in principle exceed V_true (canonical stall: min of x*y over [-1,1]^2 from the origin returns 0, not -1). restart_gap monitors non-global stalls (~1e-12 at the c=0.03 projected operating point, so empirically tight here). Below coverage onset, validity additionally leans on plug-in near-unbiasedness. The projected variant stays informative where vanilla does not.

audit_entry9_4lens.method: 4 lens-specific reviewers (theory / software-perf / empirical-skeptic / peer-review). MAJOR_REFRAME_projected_pessimism_NOT_a_.finding: Agent A (high, verified by reproducing the unit-test AND measuring real-data leak): the signal-PROJECTED region structurally EXCLUDES the true bridge whenever it leaks out of the identified subspace. On the real toy the true bridges leak up to 21% of their norm (bR_t3 leak 0.38 / norm 1.80). So the projected region NEVER honestly contains the truth.
MAJOR_REFRAME_projected_pessimism_NOT_a_.consequence: The Entry-5 headline 'signal-projected repair achieves coverage=1 at c=0.03' was an ARTIFACT of coverage_report checking only the truth's PROJECTION. With honest leak-gating (coverage requires leak <= 5% of ||b_true||), projected joint_coverage = 0 at ALL widths. The projection is a HEURISTIC, not a sound pessimistic bound: it keeps V_low informative and empirically selects the right policy (regret 0 at c=0.03, all seeds), and V_low <= V_true still held empirically at every width -- but by SIGN-ALIGNMENT, not containment. Honest headline is now a COVERAGE/INFORMATIVENESS TENSION: vanilla covers the truth (c>=0.1) but V_low blows up and mis-selects (regret 0.68); projected stays informative and selects correctly but never covers.
MAJOR_REFRAME_projected_pessimism_NOT_a_.fixes: coverage_report now gates 'covered' on BOTH in-subspace fit AND small leak (leak_frac_tol=0.05); returns max_subspace_leakage. BlockEllipsoid docstring: removed the unverified 'value-irrelevant' premise, added SOUNDNESS CAVEAT. proposal PoC(v) fully rewritten (heuristic not repair). fig4 relabeled 'coverage/informativeness tension'. This is DISTINCT from Entry-8's coordinate-descent finding (that was about not reaching the global inner min; this is about the feasible set excluding the truth).

MAJOR_REFRAME_benchmark_more_negative.finding: Agent C (high, verified): the plug-in is WORSE than naive in 15/16 benchmark cells vs population-naive (14/16 vs empirical-naive), not a wash. Harm is largest at kappa=0 (NO confounding): 23-46x the naive bias at N=20k. Plug-in bias also non-monotone in N (grows 20k->60k for 2/4 policies).
MAJOR_REFRAME_benchmark_more_negative.consequence: Entry-6/8 framing 'variance merely exceeds the small structural bias' UNDERSTATED it -- the estimator is strictly dominated by naive at every feasible-N benchmark point, worst where there is nothing to correct. phase2_estimation.stage1_closed_forms: ridge CME mu_hat(w|x) = count1(w,x)/(count1(x) + N1*lambda1) [push-through-equivalent to Gamma = (K_X+N1 lam1 I)^{-1} K_XX']; pmf target p_hat(y|x) = MLE counts with marginal fallback (unseen-x rows are inert: mu_hat = 0)

PRIMAL: (T2 + lam2 I) vec(b) = g2, T2 = Psi^T Psi/N2, D = |W||Y| <= 54. Verified identical to 2.4e-15
